withdrawnAlignments.oldClaim: Research in a Sustainable Delta addresses an important part of the educational function of Interdisciplinary Research Design, namely planning and carrying out an interdisciplinary team research project on a real problem; it differs in that its subject is sustainability and the problem is set by an external partner.

Introduction to Data Science directly addresses the data-handling part of Working with Big Data: cleaning, manipulating, visualizing and analysing data (including text and spatial data) from the social sciences and humanities, at an introductory rather than big-data level.

Media Archaeology addresses an important part of ICT Revolutions: Continuity and Change, namely how successive media technologies transform the circulation and preservation of knowledge; it is limited to pre-digital media and does not cover the digital revolution itself.

Ethics directly addresses the ethical-reasoning purpose of The 'Good Life': both examine what is good and how to reason about moral questions; UCR's course treats ethics generally and does not focus on technology.

Business & Economy in the Age of AI directly addresses an important part of Social and Environmental Impacts of the Digital Economy: the economic, labour-market, inequality, climate and societal impacts of AI and digital technology, with attention to AI governance and ethics.

retainedPartialAlignments.qualification: Research Methods & Statistics teaches research design, sampling, surveys and introductory statistics. It provides related introductory research skills; the methods, assessment and full scope of Maastricht’s 5 EC component are not treated as identical.

Statistics & Experimental Methods teaches multivariate modelling, regression, factor analysis and analysis of variance, with applications to human phenomena. These are related quantitative tools; the courses’ coverage, assessment and EC differ.

Qualitative Research Methodology teaches research design, data collection, interpretation and a group project. It provides related qualitative research skills; the courses’ specific methods, assessment and EC are not treated as identical.

Introduction to Programming teaches Python, testing, debugging and computational problem-solving. It contributes programming foundations to the target’s coding strand, but does not establish coverage of the whole Digital Technologies I component.

From T.V. to TikTok analyses American mainstream-media narratives and their relationship with society, including podcasts and TikTok. It contributes to the broad digital-culture focus; it does not reproduce virtual-worlds or immersive-media study.
